collection.title: MG ZS Hatchback 2001 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a MG ZS Hatchback 2001 to 2004 model which requires a 20" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this MG ZS, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
